title: Standard Area Measurements for local authority districts, December 2024
description: ONS Standard Area Measurements: the extent of the realm, coastal, inland water and land areas of each UK local authority district, in hectares. Land area is the denominator ONS uses for published population density.

files.note: 361 local authority districts on the December 2024 code vintage, extracted from the ONS Open Geography feature service. Areas are hectares. AREALHECT (land) excludes inland water and is the denominator ONS uses for density; AREAEHECT (extent of the realm) is larger and must not be substituted.
